- Entry signal: sma crossover. Bullish when the 5-bar sma of the close crosses above the 100-bar sma (it was at or below it on the previous bar and is strictly above it now); bearish on the mirror-image cross below.
- Direction: long and short (a bullish signal opens a long when flat, a bearish one opens a short when flat).
- Position size: a fixed 0.75 of equity per trade.
- Moving box: the trade lives in a box anchored at the entry price, with the stop 2 x entry ATR behind the anchor and the target 2 x entry ATR beyond it. Every time a bar closes at least another 2 x entry ATR in profit beyond the current anchor, shift the whole box (anchor, stop and target) 2 x entry ATR in the trade's favour (repeat if the close cleared several steps). The box never shifts back.
- Time stop: if the trade is still open 32 bars after the signal bar, exit at the next open (decide on the bar where bars-since-signal reaches 32).
- Trailing stop: track the best price of the trade (highest high for longs, lowest low for shorts, starting from the entry price and updated with each bar's high/low while the position is held); the stop sits 3 x entry ATR behind that extreme.
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

- Entry signal: breakout then retest. Arming, expiry and triggering are checked on every bar, in or out of a position; a newer breakout in either direction replaces the armed setup.

- Cooldown: after any trade ends, take no new entry for 16 bars, counted from the bar on which you first see yourself flat (entries allowed again from that bar + 16).
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

- Entry signal: range-box breakout. The box is the highest high and lowest low of the 32 bars before the current bar. It only counts as a box if its height (top minus bottom) is at most 3 times the current ATR(14). Bullish when the close is strictly above the top of a valid box; bearish when the close is strictly below its bottom.
- Direction: long only (bearish signals only close longs).
- Trend filter on completed 60-minute candles: only take long entries when the last completed 60-minute close is strictly above the 20-period EMA of those candles' closes, and only take short entries when it is strictly below. The filter only blocks entries, never exits.
- Position size: a fixed 0.5 of equity per trade.
- Cooldown: after any trade ends, take no new entry for 48 bars, counted from the bar on which you first see yourself flat (entries allowed again from that bar + 48).
- Protective stop 1 x entry ATR away from the entry price (below for longs, above for shorts).
- Trailing stop: track the best price of the trade (highest high for longs, lowest low for shorts, starting from the entry price and updated with each bar's high/low while the position is held); the stop sits 1.5 x entry ATR behind that extreme.
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

- Entry signal: RSI(21) mean reversion. Bullish when RSI crosses back up through 25 (below 25 on the previous bar, at or above 25 now); bearish when it crosses back down through 100-25 (above it on the previous bar, at or below it now).
- Direction: long and short (a bullish signal opens a long when flat, a bearish one opens a short when flat).
- Trend filter on completed 240-minute candles: only take long entries when the last completed 240-minute close is strictly above the 20-period EMA of those candles' closes, and only take short entries when it is strictly below. The filter only blocks entries, never exits.
- Position size: a fixed 0.5 of equity per trade.
- Daily cap: at most 3 new entries per UTC calendar day (by the signal bar's open time); further signals that day are ignored.
- Trailing stop: track the best price of the trade (highest high for longs, lowest low for shorts, starting from the entry price and updated with each bar's high/low while the position is held); the stop sits 3 x entry ATR behind that extreme.
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.
